name: PPSA01325: Native RT and GI (emulator trigger-state fix required)

mods.name: Select the existing non-tiled deferred-lighting renderer

notes: Experimental native-rendering profile. All GI and renderer bypasses are disabled. Select this JSON instead of the original bypass patch and enable emulator ray tracing, or use tools/run-native-rt.ps1. Trigger gameplay correction is in the updated emulator, not game memory writes. Full RT startup still needs shader resource-planning fixes; this is not a verified optimized or crash-free RT patch.
